instructions: Read every complete case in the paired workbook. The default is only a draft. Put a full Decision object in Override for every contradiction, then sign reviewedAllCases. The compiler refuses unsigned or candidate-less rows.

rows.Kwic: 曰如何是賓中主。師曰。對面無儔侶。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Fenyang Shanzhao section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks what guest within host is, and Fenyang answers that face-to-face there is no companion. All six rungs preserve no personal name for the monk.

rows.Kwic: 眉分八字。曰未審意旨如何。師曰。雙耳垂肩。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Shexian Guisheng section. The exact actor is an unnamed questioning monk: after Shexian answers 'the brows divide like the graph eight,' the monk asks what the meaning is. All six rungs leave him unnamed.

rows.Kwic: 上堂良久曰。夫行脚禪流直須著忖。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Shexian Guisheng section. Shexian Guisheng is the exact speaker: in his own hall address he remains silent for a long time and then tells travelling Chan students that they must take thought and possess the eye of study.

rows.Kwic: 。師便出問。如何是正覺無名相。丈曰。汝還見露柱麼。師曰。如何是隨緣即道場。丈曰。今日結夏。次參首山問。學人親到寶山空手回時如何。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Guyin Yuncong biography. Guyin Yuncong is the exact questioner: while studying under Baizhang Heng, he asks what 'following conditions is precisely the site of the Way' means; Baizhang answers, 'today the summer retreat begins.'

rows.Kwic: 如何是佛。師曰。卭州多出九節杖。曰謝師指示。師曰。且莫作答佛話會却。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Guyin Yuncong section. Guyin Yuncong is the exact speaker: after answering what Buddha is, he warns the monk not to understand it as a stock answer-to-Buddha expression.

rows.Kwic: 良久曰。春雨一滴滑如油。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Guyin Yuncong section. Guyin Yuncong is the exact speaker: after asking for a phrase that receives spring rain's beneficence, he remains silent for a long time and says that one drop of spring rain is slick as oil.

rows.Kwic: 曰如何是奪境不奪人。師曰。暗傳天子勅。倍行一百程。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Sanjiao Zhisong section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: in a fourfold exchange he asks what taking away the object but not the person is; Sanjiao answers with secretly transmitting the emperor's decree. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

rows.Kwic: 猶未是金剛眼睛在。如何是金剛眼睛。良久曰瞎。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Jinshan Tanying section. Jinshan Tanying is the exact speaker: in his own hall address he asks what the diamond eye is, remains silent for a long time, and answers, 'blind.'

rows.Kwic: 張三李四賣囂虛。拾得寒山爭賤貴。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Lingyin Yunzhi section. Lingyin Yunzhi is the exact speaker and verse author: his hall verse says Zhang the Third and Li the Fourth sell empty clamor while Shide and Hanshan dispute cheap and dear.

rows.Kwic: 汝記得話頭麼試舉看。師擬對。鑑掩其口。師了然開悟遂禮拜。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Touzi Yiqing biography. Touzi Yiqing is the exact grammatical actor: when Fushan Fayuan asks him to raise the remembered saying, Touzi starts to answer and Fushan covers his mouth.

rows.Kwic: 上堂。古人道。認著依前還不是。實難會。土宿頷下髭鬚多。波斯眼深鼻孔大。

ActorAttribution.ActorLabel: the unnamed ancient teacher quoted by Daowu Wuzhen

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Daowu Wuzhen section. The exact actor is the unnamed ancient teacher quoted by Daowu Wuzhen: Daowu introduces the line only with 'an ancient said,' then quotes 'recognize it and, as before, it still is not.' Six-rung review supplies no personal name.

rows.Kwic: 祖師西來道箇休歇。敢問諸人。作麼生是休歇處。還會麼。寒則圍爐座。閑時任性眠。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Zishou Chuyan section. Zishou Chuyan is the exact speaker: in his own hall address he asks what the resting place proclaimed by the patriarch's coming from the West is, then answers with sitting by the stove when cold and sleeping freely when idle.

rows.Kwic: 金剛眼睛十二兩。衲僧手裏秤頭低。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Wuzu Fayan section. Wuzu Fayan is the exact speaker: his hall address weighs the diamond eye at twelve ounces and says the scale-beam hangs low in a patch-robed monk's hand.

rows.Kwic: 一者祖師巴鼻。二具金剛眼睛。三有師子爪牙。四得衲僧殺活。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Letan Shanqing's opening hall address quoting Fushan Fayuan. Fushan Fayuan is the exact quoted speaker who lists the diamond eye as the second of four things needed to display a lineage master's path.

rows.Kwic: 而今得箇休歇處。依然見山秖是山。見水秖是水。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Qingyuan Weixin section. Qingyuan Weixin is the exact speaker: recounting his three stages of seeing mountains and waters, he says that now he has obtained a resting place and again sees mountains simply as mountains and waters as waters.

rows.Kwic: 公釋然即拜之曰。和尚得恁麼老婆心切。堂笑曰。秖要公到家耳。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Huang Tingjian biography. Huang Tingjian is the exact speaker: after Huanglong Zuxin's response releases his doubt, Huang bows and says that the master's grandmotherly concern is so earnest.

rows.Kwic: 萬法若無處處沈空滯寂。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Yuwang Duanyu section. Yuwang Duanyu is the exact speaker: in his own instruction he contrasts positing one dharma as iron walls and silver mountains with positing no dharmas and everywhere sinking into emptiness and stagnating in quiescence.

rows.Kwic: 明暗不相干。彼此分一半。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Lingyin Huiyuan section. Lingyin Huiyuan is the exact speaker and verse author: in his dated hall address he says light and dark have nothing to do with each other and this and that divide one half.

rows.Kwic: 如何是善知識。臣云。燈籠露柱猫兒狗子。皆稱善知識何必更問。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Lingyin Huiyuan's report before the emperor. Lingyin Huiyuan is the exact quoted self-speaker marked 臣云: answering Zeng Kai's question, he says lanterns, pillars, cats, and dogs are all called good teachers and asks why another must be sought.

rows.Kwic: 我有一句子。不借諸聖口。不動自己舌。非聲氣呼吸。非情識分別。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Huanglong Fazhong section. Huanglong Fazhong is the exact speaker: in his own hall address he says he has a phrase that does not borrow the sages' mouths, move his own tongue, consist in breath and voice, or divide through discriminating consciousness.

rows.Kwic: 蓋為地水火風因緣和合暫時湊泊。不可錯認為己有。

Override.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Qian Duanli biography following the Huazang Zhishen notice. Qian Duanli is the exact author of the written death instruction: he says earth, water, fire, and wind temporarily gather through conditions and must not mistakenly be recognized as one's possession.
